name: ForceOwnerCrown
description: Force the owner crown next to usernames even if the server is large.
summary: The owner crown in the member list even in large servers
notes: Qord's member list shows a crown ("Server Owner") next to the server's owner, and leaves it out in servers of 1,000 members or more; with this plugin the crown shows in every server.
gaps: Discord's exact rule for hiding the crown isn't documented; Qord's 1,000-member limit is its own reading, and the crown isn't hidden when the owner is listed under a separately shown role.
